mapper.select: SELECT SUBJECT_NO code,SUBJECT_NAME name,SUBJECT_NAME shortName,SUBJECT_NO hidCode,SUBJECT_NAME linkValue FROM BOK_SUBJECT

SELECT DISTINCT SUBJECT_NO id, SUBJECT_NAME text FROM BOK_SUBJECT
to_number(subject_level) = #{subjectLevel}
AND SUBJECT_NO like '%' || #{search} || '%'
order by SUBJECT_NO

SELECT DISTINCT SUBJECT_LEVEL id, SUBJECT_LEVEL text FROM BOK_SUBJECT
to_number(subject_level) >= ( select DISTINCT to_number(SUBJECT_LEVEL) from BOK_SUBJECT where SUBJECT_NO = #{subjectNo} )
AND SUBJECT_LEVEL = #{search}
order by SUBJECT_LEVEL

SELECT DISTINCT A.SUBJECT_NO code,A.SUBJECT_NAME name,A.SUBJECT_NAME shortName,A.SUBJECT_NO hidCode,A.SUBJECT_NAME linkValue FROM BOK_SUBJECT A LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT B ON A.SUBJECT_NO = B.FSUBJECT_ID WHERE B.SUBJECT_NO IS NOT NULL
select count(1) from BOK_SUBJECT where BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} and SUBJECT_NO = #{subjectNo}

SELECT DISTINCT SUBJECT_NAME id, SUBJECT_NAME text FROM BOK_SUBJECT
to_number(subject_level) = #{subjectLevel}
AND SUBJECT_NAME like '%' || #{search} || '%'
order by SUBJECT_NAME
select count(*) from BOK_SUBJECT where SUBJECT_NO = #{subjectNo} and STATUS IN ('A','E')

select BS.SUBJECT_NO as subjectNo, BS.SUBJECT_NAME as subjectName, BS.FSUBJECT_ID as fsubjectId,
BS.SUBJECT_TYPE as subjectType, BS.SUBJECT_LEVEL as subjectLevel, BS.CREATE_USER as createUser, BS.CREATE_DEPT as createDept, BS.CREATE_TIME as createTime, BS.UPDATE_USER as updateUser, BS.UPDATE_TIME as updateTime, BS.UPDATE_TIME as updateDate, BS.DATA_SOURCE as dataSource, BS.STATUS as status, BS.REMARK as remark, BS.DESCRIBE as describe from BOK_SUBJECT BS where SUBJECT_NO = #{subjectNo}
